title: Permission from State Commission
description: Institution of complaint in State Commission

content.general_rule: A complaint shall be instituted in a State Commission within the limits of whose jurisdiction the opposite party or each of the opposite parties resides or carries on business or has a branch office or personally works for gain
content.exception: Does not apply without permission of the State Commission in case of actual and voluntary residence or business of opposite party
conditions: permission of the State Commission is given
